sources.label: Wikipedia, "HD 224693"
sources.quote: HD 224693, also named Axólotl, is a star in the equatorial constellation of Cetus, and is positioned near the western constellation border with Aquarius.

introduction.text: Gaia's parallax, brightness and spectrum give it 1.9 solar radii and 1.17 solar masses (FLAME) and 5,815 K at its surface (GSP-Phot).

sources.label: Creevey et al. (2023), Astronomy & Astrophysics 674 A26

sources.label: Wikipedia, "HD 224693"
sources.quote: It can be viewed with a small telescope but is too faint to be seen with the naked eye, having an apparent visual magnitude of 8.23.
